Leucobryaceae.key_door: pale compact cushion + leaf dominated by broad multilayered leucocyst-rich costa + narrow lamina

Leucodontaceae.key_door: pleurocarpous bark/rock moss + short curved julaceous branches + tightly appressed ecostate leaves

Pottiaceae.key_door: acrocarpous squarrosa-type moss + crisp/contorted dry leaves + squarrose-recurved wet leaves + strong costa + papillose distal cells

taxonomy_notes: Current WFO backbone places Leucobryaceae in Archidiales, Leucodontaceae in Hypnales, and Pottiaceae in Pottiales.
Leucobryum albidum and Leucodon julaceus are accepted in current FNA/WFO treatments and FNA includes Texas.

Source Tortella squarrosa is retained as searchable provenance. WFO recognizes Tortella squarrosa globally, while FNA excludes Pleurochaete squarrosa sensu stricto from the New World and treats North American squarrosa-like material as Pleurochaete luteola.
Texas Tortella/Pleurochaete source material therefore requires microscope/specimen review before current species promotion.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Do not silently rename Tortella squarrosa to Pleurochaete luteola at family level.
